faqList.question: What is the Flipkart Offers store?
faqList.answer: Flipkart Offers store is your one-stop destination to get exciting deals and discounts on a wide variety of products. The Flipkart Offers store gives you access to special limited time deals as well as information on ongoing and upcoming sales. You can filter the products on display by category, brand, and more to get access to high value deals.

faqList.question: What are the products on sale in the Flipkart Offers store?
faqList.answer: The Flipkart Offers store gives you access to deals and discounts on a wide variety of products ranging from home and kitchen appliances like grinders, washing machines, coffee makers, and more to fashion and lifestyle products like T-shirts, cargo pants, sneakers, and more.

faqList.question: What are the payment options available on the Flipkart Offers store?
faqList.answer: You can choose to pay via a variety of methods. These include UPI, Credit/Debit Cards, Net Banking, Cash on Delivery, and more. Flipkart also has partnerships with various banking institutions, thus giving you access to special offers depending on the card or bank you choose to pay from.
